analyst_view.overall: Two struggling sides meet on Monday night: Monza (Ivan Juric) are 18th with 7 points after losing four of five, the last 1-0 at home to Atalanta, and Fiorentina (Paolo Vanoli) are 15th with 9 points after three games unbeaten. Both have scored 17 and conceded 25, far more than their expected goals against, and Monza's Gustavo Varela leads the league with nine goals. Monza have captain Pessina, Ziolkowski, Birindelli and Robinson back in the group, while Folorunsho is still on a separate programme (counted out) and Maye is day to day. Fiorentina miss Pongracic and Parisi (counted), but Ndour is reported fully recovered, Njie is favoured to start and Atta may make the squad. Referee Daniele Doveri is one of the most lenient in Serie A (2.7 cards a game), which the numbers already count.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.1 goals, already adding a little for both sides' recent scoring and leaky defending. Both teams are close to full strength beyond the players the numbers already count (Pessina and Robinson back for Monza, Ndour and Njie for Fiorentina), and both concede far more than their chances allow, so I stay at about 3.1.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.5 corners, already nudging up for Fiorentina's recent corner count. Monza's wing-back 3-4-2-1 and Fiorentina's 4-2-3-1 with Mastantuono and Njie wide don't point either way beyond what the numbers see, so I stay at about 8.5.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.3 cards, already cut by 30% for Doveri's lenient record, which I don't size again. This is a relegation scrap with no stakes flag in the brief: a Monza win would lift them past Fiorentina, which tends to bring more fouls than a usual Doveri game; a mild lean up to about 3.4.

shots.text: The numbers say 28.9 shots, already raised strongly for both sides' recent shooting (+9% Monza, +13% Fiorentina, fifth in the league for shots). Returns on both sides (Pessina and Robinson; Ndour) balance out, so I stay at about 28.9.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.0 shots on target, already lifted around 10% for each side's recent form. Monza are the league's most accurate shooters (42% on target) with Varela fit, while Fiorentina shoot often but only 30% on target with Pellegrino up front; that is the picture the numbers already have, so about 10.
